description: Third slice. Extend the collect_local_*_requirements pre-pass and the Pattern::Struct/Expr::Struct walks in jobs/body.rs to record struct field obligations and wait on StructDefined(A) instead of synchronously requiring module_struct_fields and emitting a fatal LOWER_UNSUPPORTED. Tests: #1 out-of-order (B references %A{field:...} before A defined; records obligations, waits only on StructDefined(A), succeeds after A publishes), #2 missing-field (no immediate fatal if A pending; after A settles diagnostic points to B usage span), #4 pattern/literal lowering consumes ordered schema from StructDefined(A) not ModuleDefined/source scans. Needs the obligation store slice.
title: Structs: body.rs lowering records obligations + waits on StructDefined; kill synchronous-fatal path
